lessonTitle: 27. The volume of a rectangular box
lessonTitleEnglish: The volume of a rectangular box
unit: Geometry · Chapter I. Volumes of solids
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 12 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: The volume of a rectangular box is the product of its three dimensions: V = abc.
stages.headlineEnglish: The volume of a rectangular box is the product of its three dimensions: V = abc.

stages.headline: Equivalently V = S(base) · h; for a cube V = a³.
stages.headlineEnglish: Equivalently V = S(base) · h; for a cube V = a³.

stages.headline: Example: a 2 × 3 × 5 box has volume 30 and a cube with edge 4 has volume 64.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: a 2 × 3 × 5 box has volume 30 and a cube with edge 4 has volume 64.
